===Adjective===
{{en-adj|-}}

# Of the [[physical]] [[sense]]s or [[sensation]].
#* {{quote-journal|en|year=1991|author=Tetsuo Matsui; Susumu Kato; Susan E. Smith|title=Biology and Potential Use of Pacific Grenadier, ''Coryphaenoides acrolepis'', off California|journal=Marine Fisheries Review|volume=52|number=3|issn=0090-1830|url=http://aquaticcommons.org/9929|page=13|text=Findings of the '''sensory''' analysis panel at NWFSC [the {{w|Northwest Fisheries Science Center}}], which tested and classified flesh characteristics of both Pacific and giant grenadier, are averaged and summarized in Table 10.}}
# {{lb|en|neuroanatomy}} [[convey|Convey]]ing [[nerve impulse]]s from the [[sense organ]]s to the [[nerve center]]s.
#: {{syn|en|afferent}}
#: {{ux|en|'''sensory''' neurons}}

# {{lb|en|biology|dated}} The [[sensorium]].<ref>{{R:Webster 1913}}</ref>
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1704|author=Sir {{w|Isaac Newton}}|title=w:Opticks|edition=3rd|location=London|publisher=W. and J. Innys|year_published=1721|page=344|pageurl=https://books.google.com/books?id=1cAUAAAAQAAJ&pg=PA344|passage=Is not the '''Senſory''' of Animals that place to which the ſenſitive Subſtance is preſent, and into which the ſenſible Species of Things are carried through the Nerves and Brain, that there they may be perceived by their immediate preſence to that ſubſtance ?}}
